issues.title: var used instead of const
issues.description: The rule requires that all variable declarations use let or const instead of var, but var was used to declare the newValues variable
issues.rule_name: Code Must Use let or const Instead of var

issues.title: Race condition: search input cleared synchronously causes visual glitch
issues.description: The handleClose function was modified to clear the search input synchronously using setSearchInput('') instead of the debounced setTimeout(() => setSearchInput(''), 200). This creates a race condition where the search input is cleared while the popover closing animation is still running, causing a visible flash where the filtered results disappear before the popover closes. The original implementation used a 200ms delay to allow the popover animation to complete before clearing the search state, preventing visual artifacts. This bug affects user experience by showing jarring UI state changes during the transition.

issues.title: Missing handleClose call in single-select mode prevents search input cleanup
issues.description: In the unselected options section for single-select mode, the code calls setOpen(false) but fails to call handleClose(), unlike the multiselect path which properly calls handleClose() when autoCloseOnSelect is enabled. This means when a user selects a single option, the popover closes but the search input state is never cleared, causing the next time the popover opens to show stale search results and filtered options from the previous interaction. The handleClose() function is responsible for clearing the search input and triggering the onClose callback, both of which are now skipped in single-select scenarios.

issues.title: Memory leak: temporary selected values not cleared on filter popover close
issues.description: The onClose handler in the SelectOptionsPopover component was modified to remove the setTempSelectedValues([]) cleanup call. This causes a memory leak where tempSelectedValues state persists after the popover closes. When a user opens the add filter popover, selects a field that supports options, starts selecting values, then closes the popover without confirming, those temporary values remain in state. If the user then opens a different field's options, they may see incorrect pre-selected values carried over from the previous interaction. The original PR correctly added this cleanup in line 2102 to ensure temporary state is cleared, but this bug removes it causing state pollution across different filter field selections.

issues.title: autoCloseOnSelect fails to close popover in non-inline multiselect mode
issues.description: The autoCloseOnSelect feature was implemented inconsistently across inline and non-inline modes. In non-inline Popover mode (line 1135-1137), when a multiselect option is selected with autoCloseOnSelect enabled, the code only calls onClose?.() without calling setOpen(false). Since SelectOptionsPopover can be instantiated without an onClose prop (line 1598), the optional chaining results in a no-op, leaving the popover open despite user selection. This breaks the intended UX where the dropdown should close immediately after selection when autoCloseOnSelect is configured. The inline mode implementation (line 1272-1273) correctly calls handleClose() which performs both operations.

issues.title: Double-quoted string literal used in JSX attribute
issues.description: Rule requires single quotes for string literals. The updated JSX uses a double-quoted string for the className attribute in the modified line.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #25574 - Analytics filter refinements

structured_output.summary:
This PR polishes the analytics filter UI in two places. The shared `@tryghost/shade` `Filters` component gets an opt-in `autoCloseOnSelect` field flag, a reset of the selected field when the add-filter popover closes, a `self-stretch` operator label, and a few class tweaks. The Stats app's `stats-filter.tsx` is restyled to match: icon-only "add filter" button, a funnel icon, count badges switched to mono text, UTM and source chips hidden from the add popover, and the audience field turned into a hidden-operator multiselect that auto-closes after one pick. Small header padding and whitespace cleanups round it out.

The state-handling changes are sound. Resetting `selectedFieldKeyForOptions` on close fixes stale state, and `autoCloseOnSelect` is a clean opt-in. Three things need fixing before merge. The add button now has no accessible name, because the i18n defaults were blanked and the Stats app always passes an empty `addButtonText`. The audience field's `defaultOperator` is the label `'is any of'` rather than the operator key `'is_any_of'`. And the "disable close animation" classes don't match any Tailwind utility, so they don't do what they say. There are also a few smaller style and consistency issues. The PR adds no tests for the new close and auto-close behaviour, and the shade package has no filter tests to extend.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The icon-only add button regresses accessibility: the button has no visible text, no `title`, and no `aria-label`. The audience field persists an operator value that isn't in the shade operator list (`is_any_of`), which is inconsistent with every other multiselect and may break any code that switches on the operator. The close-animation override is a silent no-op. These should be fixed. The rest are small cleanups.

architecture.overview:
The shared `Filters` component in `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx` renders the filter bar and its add-filter popover. The add flow is a field picker that opens `SelectOptionsPopover` in `inline` mode, which emits `onChange` into `addFilterWithOption`, which in turn updates the controlled `filters` array through the parent's `onChange`. The Stats app supplies the field list, options, and icons through `StatsFilter` in `apps/stats/src/views/Stats/components/stats-filter.tsx`, and that component owns the filter state through `handleFilterChange`.

The PR adds an `autoCloseOnSelect` flag on `FilterFieldConfig`, which closes the inline popover after a multiselect pick. It also resets the selected field when the popover closes, so the next open starts clean. On the Stats side, the audience field becomes a hidden-operator multiselect that auto-closes, the UTM and source chips hide their selected-options list via the existing `selectedOptionsClassName` prop, and the add button becomes icon-only using `addButtonText` set to an empty string.
steps: Entry point: `Filters` renders the add button and a `PopoverContent`. Its className now prefers `selectedFieldForOptions.className`, then `popoverContentClassName`, then `w-[200px]`.
Field picker: choosing a field sets `selectedFieldKeyForOptions` and seeds `tempSelectedValues`. The inline `SelectOptionsPopover` then renders that field's options.

Selection path: single-select calls `addFilterWithOption(..., closePopover=true)`. Multiselect calls it with `closePopover=false`, so the popover stays open until `onClose` runs. The new `autoCloseOnSelect` flag makes multiselect call `onClose` after the value is written.
Close path: `onClose` now clears `selectedFieldKeyForOptions` as well as hiding the popover, so reopening starts from the field picker rather than the last field.

Stats wiring: `StatsFilter` builds the field list. Audience becomes a multiselect with `defaultOperator: 'is any of'` and `autoCloseOnSelect: true`. The post field gets a wider popover, and the UTM, source, and audience fields hide their selected chips in the add popover.

findings.title: Add-filter button has no accessible name
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx`, `DEFAULT_I18N.addFilter` and `addFilterTitle` were changed to `''` (around lines 105 and 122), and the `Filters` add button (around lines 2070-2074) renders `{addButtonText || mergedI18n.addFilter}` with `title={mergedI18n.addFilterTitle}`. Stats passes `addButtonText={filters.length ? '' : ''}` at `apps/stats/src/views/Stats/components/stats-filter.tsx` line 498. Together these produce an icon-only button with no accessible name. Restore non-empty default labels, or add an `aria-label` to the button built from a non-empty i18n string. Remove the no-op ternary in stats-filter. Keep the icon-only look if it is intended. Match the existing button attribute conventions in this file.

findings.title: Audience field persists a non-canonical operator 'is any of'
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/stats/src/views/Stats/components/stats-filter.tsx` line 453, the audience multiselect field sets `defaultOperator: 'is any of'`. The operator key used by `createOperatorsFromI18n` in `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx` (around line 800) is `is_any_of`; `'is any of'` is only the display label. Change the value to `'is_any_of'` so the stored filter matches the other multiselect fields and the operator lookup succeeds. Check that nothing else in the Stats app relies on the old string.

findings.title: Close-animation override uses a class that doesn't exist
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx`, three `PopoverContent` classNames add `data-[state=closed]:!animation-none data-[state=closed]:!duration-0` (around lines 1204, 1644, and 2081). `animation-none` is not a Tailwind utility, and `duration-0` only sets transition-duration, so the close animation from `popover.tsx` (`data-[state=closed]:animate-out`) is not disabled. Replace with the working utility, `data-[state=closed]:!animate-none`, and drop `!duration-0` unless you can show it has an effect. Confirm in the browser or generated CSS that the closing popover no longer animates, and update all three sites consistently.

findings.title: Auto-close paths are inconsistent and the inline one skips cleanup
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx`, `SelectOptionsPopover` has two `autoCloseOnSelect` branches. The inline one (around line 1135) calls `onClose?.()` directly, and the non-inline one (around line 1272) calls `handleClose()`. Make them consistent. Ideally both call a single close helper that clears `searchInput` and invokes `onClose`. Be careful with the inline case: `onClose` is supplied by `Filters` and must still run after `onChange` so the filter is written first.

findings.title: Stray `var` in a click handler
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx` around line 1125, `var newValues` was introduced in the inline multiselect `onSelect` handler. Change it back to `const` to match the rest of the file.

findings.title: Popover width precedence silently drops the Filters-level prop
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/shade/src/components/ui/filters.tsx` around line 2082, the `Filters` popover className now uses `selectedFieldForOptions?.className || popoverContentClassName || 'w-[200px]'`, which means a field-level `className` drops the prop-level `popoverContentClassName`. Decide whether that precedence is intended. If it is, document it in the field config comment. If not, merge the two with `cn`. Also remove the redundant duplicate `className`/`popoverContentClassName` pair on the post field in `apps/stats/src/views/Stats/components/stats-filter.tsx` around lines 468-469 once the precedence is settled.

findings.title: No tests cover the new close and auto-close behaviour
findings.body:
The PR changes stateful UI behaviour: auto-close on multiselect, clearing the selected field on close, and the single-select close path that moved from `handleClose()` to `setOpen(false)`. There are no test changes. A search of the shade and stats apps found no filter test files. `filters.stories.tsx` is the only existing coverage, and it is a story, not an assertion.

A small interaction test would catch regressions like the stale field state this PR fixes: select a multiselect value with `autoCloseOnSelect`, confirm the popover closes and the filter is written, then reopen and confirm the field picker is shown.
findings.fixPrompt: Add an interaction test for the `Filters` component in `apps/shade` covering: (a) a multiselect field with `autoCloseOnSelect: true` writes the filter and closes the popover after one selection; (b) after closing, reopening the add popover shows the field picker, not the previous field's options. Use the existing test setup in the shade package. Do not snapshot-test the markup.

findings.title: Close-path reset fixes stale add-filter state
findings.body:
The `onClose` handler now clears `selectedFieldKeyForOptions` alongside hiding the popover. Before this change, closing the popover after picking a field left that key set, so the next open could render the previous field's options instead of the field picker. The fix is small and sits in the right place, because the only callers of `onClose` are the inline selection paths. The change is correct as written.

findings.fixPrompt: No change needed. This is noted so reviewers can see the stale-state fix.
